"""Independent black-box verification of a compiler response."""
import ipaddress, json, random, sys
sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace'); sys.path.insert(0,'/workspace/submission')
from audit import decode_image, WIDTH, LANES
import ref

U=1<<128
FULL=(1<<128)-1

def parse_prefix(text):
    addr,ln=text.split("/")
    ln=int(ln)
    v=int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(addr))
    size=1<<(128-ln)
    return v//size*size, ln

def brute_atlas(routes):
    """routes: dict (start,length)->hop   -> (starts,hops) canonical runs"""
    pts={0}
    for (start,length) in routes:
        pts.add(start)
        end=start+(1<<(128-length))
        if end<U: pts.add(end)
    pts=sorted(pts)
    runs=[]
    for i,x in enumerate(pts):
        best=None; blen=-1
        for (start,length),hop in routes.items():
            mask = FULL ^ ((1<<(128-length))-1) if length else 0
            if x & mask == start and length>blen:
                blen=length; best=hop
        if not runs or runs[-1][1]!=best:
            runs.append((x,best))
    return [r[0] for r in runs],[r[1] for r in runs]

def hexb(x):
    return "1"+"0"*32 if x==U else "%032x"%x

def check_changes(rows, a, b):
    sa,ha=a; sb,hb=b
    bounds=sorted(set(sa)|set(sb))
    expect=[]
    for i,x in enumerate(bounds):
        nxt=bounds[i+1] if i+1<len(bounds) else U
        va=ha[max(j for j,s in enumerate(sa) if s<=x)]
        vb=hb[max(j for j,s in enumerate(sb) if s<=x)]
        if va!=vb: expect.append([x,nxt,va,vb])
    merged=[]
    for r in expect:
        if merged and merged[-1][1]==r[0] and merged[-1][2]==r[2] and merged[-1][3]==r[3]:
            merged[-1][1]=r[1]
        else: merged.append(r)
    want=[[hexb(s),hexb(e),o,n] for s,e,o,n in merged]
    return rows==want

def value_at(starts,hops,x):
    lo,hi=0,len(starts)
    while lo<hi:
        mid=(lo+hi)//2
        if starts[mid]<=x: lo=mid+1
        else: hi=mid
    return hops[lo-1], lo-1

def verify(request, result, rng=None, deep=True):
    rng=rng or random.Random(7)
    errors=[]
    assert set(result)== {"cases"}
    assert len(result["cases"])==len(request["cases"])
    total_runs=0
    all_versions=[]
    for case,res,gold in zip(request["cases"],result["cases"],gold["cases"]):
        assert set(res)=={"versions","changes","bursts","objective"}
        # rebuild versions independently
        routes={}
        for text,hop in case["initial"]:
            routes[parse_prefix(text)]=hop
        vers=[]
        vers.append(dict(routes))
        for tx in case["transactions"]:
            for change in tx:
                if change[0]=="set": routes[parse_prefix(change[1])]=change[2]
                else: routes.pop(parse_prefix(change[1]),None)
            vers.append(dict(routes))
        assert len(res["versions"])==len(vers), "version count"
        atlases=[]
        for idx,(rt,out) in enumerate(zip(vers,res["versions"])):
            assert set(out)=={"starts","hops","image"}
            s,h=brute_atlas(rt)
            total_runs+=len(s)
            atlases.append((s,h))
            starts=[int(x,16) for x in out["starts"]]
            assert starts==s, ("atlas starts v%d"%idx, starts[:8], s[:8])
            assert out["hops"]==h, ("atlas hops v%d"%idx, out["hops"], h)
            nodes,size=decode_image(out["image"], starts, out["hops"])
            # random addresses must route exactly
            for _ in range(60 if deep else 8):
                x=rng.getrandbits(128)
                off=64; depth=0
                while True:
                    depth+=1; assert depth<20
                    n=nodes[off]
                    if n["kind"]:
                        rank=n["lo"]+len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])-1
                        break
                    off=n["children"][len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])]
                want=value_at(s,h,x)
                assert (want[0],rank)==(h[rank],rank)==want, ("route mismatch", x, want, rank, h[rank])
        assert all(len(s)<=64 for s,_ in atlases), "run bound"
        assert total_runs<=128, "total run bound"
        # changes
        assert len(res["changes"])==len(case["transactions"])
        for i,row in enumerate(res["changes"]):
            assert check_changes(row, atlases[i], atlases[i+1]), ("changes v%d"%i, row)
        # bursts
        hit,miss,dec=case["costs"]["hit"],case["costs"]["miss"],case["costs"]["decode"]
        assert len(res["bursts"])==len(case["bursts"])
        work=0; pages=0
        resident=0
        version_nodes=[]
        for idx,out in enumerate(res["versions"]):
            starts=[int(x,16) for x in out["starts"]]
            nodes,size=decode_image(out["image"],starts,out["hops"])
            pages+=size
            resident+=sum(n["pages"] for n in nodes.values() if n["cached"])
            version_nodes.append((nodes,starts,out["hops"]))
        assert resident<=case["cache_pages"], ("resident",resident)
        for b,(burst,answers) in enumerate(zip(case["bursts"],res["bursts"])):
            v=burst["version"]; repeat=burst["repeat"]
            nodes,starts,hopso=version_nodes[v]
            assert len(answers)==len(burst["addresses"])
            visits={}; touched=set()
            for text,answer in zip(burst["addresses"],answers):
                x=int(ipaddress.IPv6Address(text))
                hopval,rank=value_at(starts,x)
                assert answer[0]==hopval and answer[1]==rank, ("answer",x,answer,hopval,rank)
                assert answer[2][0]==64
                # path must be the image traversal
                off=64; path=[]
                while True:
                    path.append(off); n=nodes[off]
                    if n["kind"]:
                        r=n["lo"]+len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])-1
                        break
                    off=n["children"][len([k for k in n["keys"] if k<=x])]
                assert answer[2]==path, ("path",answer[2],path)
                for o in path:
                    visits[o]=visits.get(o,0)+1; touched.add(o)
            for o in touched:
                n=nodes[o]; k=len(n["keys"])
                work+=repeat*(n["pages"]*(hit if n["cached"] else miss)
                              +((k+LANES[n["mode"]]-1)//LANES[n["mode"]]+dec[n["mode"]])*visits[o])
        assert res["objective"]==[work,pages], ("objective",res["objective"],[work,pages])
        assert res["objective"]==gold["objective"], ("GOLD OPTIMALITY",res["objective"],gold["objective"])
        all_versions.append((atlases,case))
    if deep:
        for (atlases,case),res in zip(all_versions,result["cases"]):
            check_optimal(atlases,case,res)
    return True

def check_optimal(atlases, case, res):
    import fib
    costs=(case["costs"]["hit"],case["costs"]["miss"],case["costs"]["decode"])
    per=[]
    for starts,hops in atlases:
        members=[(v,r,a) for (v,r,a) in case["bursts"] if v==starts and False]
        per.append(None)
    qts=[]
    for index,(starts,hops) in enumerate(atlases):
        members=[(index,r,a) for (v,r,a) in [(x["version"],x["repeat"],x["addresses"]) for x in case["bursts"]] if v==index]
        q,t=fib.interval_weights(starts, members)
        qts.append((q,t))
    want=ref.reference(atlases,[q for q,_ in qts],[t for _,t in qts],costs,case["cache_pages"])
    got=tuple(res["objective"])
    assert got==want, ("OPTIMALITY", got, want)
